preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some JizzJet tokens (at least enough to trigger swapAndLiquify)
Contract must have accumulated enough tokens in its balance (>= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity) from fees

exploit_hint: Deploy a malicious contract that implements a fallback/receive function. Transfer tokens to trigger swapAndLiquify when contract balance is high enough. During the ETH transfer in sendBNBToAdmin (via _adminWalletAddress.transfer), re-enter the contract by calling transfer again before state updates complete. The reentrancy occurs because sendBNBToAdmin is called after swapTokensForEth but before the contract's token balance is reduced. Use multiple reentrant calls to drain ETH from the contract.
